answer: Sybil resistance rests on a staked identity vault: before an agent may transact, it must lock a bond that every new account has to fund from a real cost source, so minting a thousand puppets means paying a thousand bonds. Identity weight scales with bonded value times tenure, not with headcount, so a raven flock of fresh addresses carries almost no voting power and its attestations are discounted until it survives independent challenges. A knoll of honest long-lived keys then outranks any manufactured crowd, and slashed bonds make the attack strictly loss-making.
